mainEntity.name: Which cloud accounting platform is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no single best platform — it depends on your industry, workflows, integrations, and team. Xero is popular for its app ecosystem, QuickBooks for smaller businesses, MYOB for some Australian payroll scenarios. The matched specialist recommends based on your specific needs, not a default.

mainEntity.name: Can you migrate my data without losing history?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — our matched specialists manage migrations cleanly, bringing across opening balances, customer/supplier records, and historical transactions where needed, then reconciling so the new system is correct from day one. Some historical detail may be summarised in very old periods, but the current position is preserved accurately.

mainEntity.name: How much does cloud accounting setup cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A straightforward setup may be $500–$2,000; a full migration with data transfer, automation, and training can be $2,000–$6,000 depending on complexity. The matched specialist gives you a clear quote after reviewing your situation. The matching itself is free.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a matched cloud accounting specialist contact me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched specialist will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your needs.

mainEntity.name: Can a cloud accounting specialist set up bank feeds and automation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched specialist configures bank feeds, bank rules, receipt capture and recurring invoices — automating the repetitive work so your books stay current with minimal manual data entry.

mainEntity.name: Can a cloud specialist train my team?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched specialist provides staff training on your platform — ensuring your team can raise invoices, reconcile transactions, and run reports correctly, so you get full value from your software investment.

Yes. The matching service is free for businesses. We are engaged by the accounting firms in our network, not by you. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched specialist, and the matched firm gives you a clear quote before any work begins.

mainEntity.name: Can a cloud specialist build custom reports and dashboards?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched specialist configures custom reporting and KPI dashboards in your platform — so you can see gross margin, cash position and key metrics at a glance, rather than digging through raw transaction lists.
